capabilities.name: MicroVM Hardware Isolation and Guaranteed Teardown
capabilities.why: Hardware-isolated microVM provisioning, execution, and guaranteed teardown prevent untrusted agent payloads from accessing host filesystems, environment secrets, or Docker daemon sockets, guaranteeing zero host compromise.

capabilities.name: Pre-Execution Security Policy Hooks and Canary Masking
capabilities.why: Pre-execution command safety hooks intercept unauthorized shell commands, unapproved tool calls, and path traversal attempts in the control plane before instructions ever reach the execution guest, providing deterministic defense-in-depth.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Ten-Step Workflow and Step-7 Failure Recovery
capabilities.why: Bounded ten-step workflow state transitions with explicit resume recovery policies enable graceful error handling of schema transformation faults at Step 7 without repeating earlier side effects or leaking resources.

capabilities.name: Concurrent Sandbox Collision Avoidance and Lifecycle Safety
capabilities.why: Concurrent multi-worker execution harness validates that multiple simultaneous guest sandboxes operate with zero naming collisions, zero database deadlocks, and guaranteed individual terminal cleanup.

capabilities.name: Hypervisor Snapshot Creation and State Rollback
capabilities.why: Cloud hypervisor snapshot creation and live rollback remain unverified on Celesto Cloud 0.1.8; GuardRail documents this limitation honestly and uses local state-checkpoint recovery instead of fabricating provider capabilities.

capabilities.name: Guest MicroVM Kernel-Level Outbound Egress Isolation
capabilities.why: MicroVM guest kernel-level outbound network filtering remains unverified on Celesto Cloud; GuardRail enforces network policy via Python control-plane hooks and mock exfiltration sinks without claiming unverified hypervisor network enforcement.
